evidence.original_label: Loong系列TCB设备 芯片贴装精度
evidence.excerpt: 其与客户联合开发的Loong系列TCB设备，采用自研“超精密高温纳米运动平台”和“多光谱视觉定位系统”，实现在450度高温，升温速率150度，降温速率50度，±1μm的芯片贴装精度，支持130×130mm超大芯片键合，较国际同行同级别设备效率提升25%；
evidence.review_notes: Confirmed against c-fol_cowos_test_20250314.html (光繌在线/c-fol.net, 2025-03-14), sentence “…实现在450度高温，升温速率150度，降温速率50度，±1μm的芯片贴装精度…” read directly from the live HTML (PDF checker correctly reports this HTML source unavailable). ±1μm is a bound — le/bounded_as_reported (as corrected at integration) is right. Confirmed in the same article that the forward-looking “目标将精度提升至±0.3μm” (next-gen Fluxless TCB target) and the “国内唯一” marketing superlative are both present in the source but correctly NOT registered under this actual-flow metric.

notes: Third-party trade press (光纤在线/c-fol.net, article dated 2025-03-14) relaying PrecisioNext's own stated chip-placement ('芯片贴装') precision for its Loong-platform TCB tool, in the context of the platform's completed CoWoS-L test-sampling milestone for a domestic AI chip. '实现...±1μm' (achieves ±1μm) is a flat achieved-value statement with no inequality wording, mapped to relation eq per the 达到/为=eq convention. This is a post-bond placement/mounting accuracy, distinct from pre-bond alignment accuracy; no alignment-accuracy figure for this platform was found in any held source. Independently corroborated (not merged, to avoid treating two differently-dated press pieces as one row) by precisionext_fsemi_loong_hbm_20240527, which separately states the Loong WS sub-series' 'highest precision' as the same ±1μm figure nine months earlier. The same c-fol article separately states a forward target of ±0.3μm for a next-generation Fluxless TCB tool still in development — a plan, not an achieved value, and NOT registered. No company or product-line revenue is disclosed in this or any other held source for PrecisioNext. CORRECTED AT INTEGRATION: the source states a ± tolerance (±1μm 的芯片贴装精度), which bounds the error magnitude rather than asserting a point value, so relation is le and precision bounded_as_reported. The original extraction recorded eq under the 达到/为 convention, but that convention is for a point figure. The atlas's five pre-existing accuracy rows all read lt from a printed ＜, including one '＜±50nm' recorded as lt on the magnitude, so recording the magnitude with the comparator the source implies is the established treatment.

evidence.original_label: SAB 82CWW系列 C2W和W2W键合技术 对准精度
evidence.excerpt: C2W和W2W键合技术实现±30nm的对准精度和±100nm的键合精度，C2W单键合头UPH最高可达1000片/小时。
evidence.review_notes: Confirmed against isabersgroup_c2w_w2w.html (isaber-s.com product-launch release, 2025-03-11), sentence “高精度、高效率： C2W和W2W键合技术实现±30nm的对准精度和±100nm的键合精度…” read directly from the live HTML text (not the PDF checker, correctly flagged unavailable for this HTML source). ±30nm is a bound not a point — le/bounded_as_reported (as corrected at integration) is right, matching the atlas's existing ±-tolerance convention. Confirmed the earlier, separate sentence in the SAME release — “提供片间同轴和红外穿透两种对准方式，对准精度优于±300nm（同轴）和±100nm（红外）” — describes the two alignment-DETECTION methods' own precision, a different quantity, and is correctly NOT the sentence this row cites.

notes: From the company's own official-site product-launch release (isaber-s.com, 2025-03-11) for the dual-mode SAB 82CWW hybrid bonder. '实现±30nm的对准精度' (achieves ±30nm alignment accuracy) mapped eq per the 达到/为 convention. The SAME release separately states two alignment-DETECTION-method precision figures earlier in the text — '±300nm（同轴）' and '±100nm（红外）' — which describe the coaxial and infrared alignment-sensing methods' own precision, not the tool's achieved bonding performance; those two figures are deliberately NOT registered under this metric to avoid conflating two differently-scoped 'precision' statements from one release (see platform notes). Independently corroborated as to product name, launch date and dual-mode description (not as to this specific number) by news.qq.com's parallel relay, qinghe_jingyuan_qq_relay_20250312. No company or product-line revenue is disclosed for Qinghe Jingyuan in any held source. CORRECTED AT INTEGRATION: the source states a ± tolerance (±30nm), which bounds the error magnitude rather than asserting a point value, so relation is le and precision bounded_as_reported. The original extraction recorded eq under the 达到/为 convention, but that convention is for a point figure; 实现±X is 'achieves within X'. The atlas's five pre-existing accuracy rows all read lt from a printed ＜, including one '＜±50nm' recorded as lt on the magnitude, so recording the magnitude with the comparator the source implies is the established treatment. These are the atlas's first rows from a bare ± spec with no comparator.
